title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive - Membership Advisor

Location: Rothwell, LeedsSalary: £27,000-£30,000 per annumContract: 6-month temporary contractHours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am-5:00pmWorking: Hybrid

We are currently recruiting for a Sales Executive / Membership Advisor to join a busy team based in Rothwell, Leeds, on a 6-month temporary contract.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous telesales and CRM experience who enjoys speaking to customers and working towards sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
- Conduct inbound and outbound telesales to increase membership
- Follow up sales enquiries and convert initial interest into full membership
- Provide a positive sales experience to potential members
- Maintain a strong knowledge of products and services available to members
- Use and maintain the CRM system, ensuring all sales activity and customer information is accurately recorded
- Achieve individual sales targets
- Keep up to date with competitor activity
- Complete sales administration and reporting
- Handle customer information in line with GDPR and data protection requirements

About You
- Previous telesales/sales experience is essential
- Strong CRM experience is essential
- Confident making and receiving telephone calls
- Comfortable working towards individual sales targets
- Excellent communication and customer service skills
- Highly organised with strong attention to detail
- Confident using computer systems
- Motivated and target-driven

What's on Offer
- £27,000-£30,000 per annum
- 6-month temporary contract
- Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm
- Hybrid working
- Rothwell, Leeds
- Great opportunity to join an established organisation

If you have telesales experience, strong CRM skills and enjoy working towards targets, we'd love to hear from you!

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.
